'''AR-312''' was a scan the [[University of Agamar|University]] of [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] science team made of a cave on [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]]. It detailed the mummified [[Mongei Shai|remains]] of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] which had been in the cave for about fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The humanoid had been defending against [[slashrat]]s, and had fallen back to the cave. It had taken out at least two slashrats before dying, and had weapons and armor nearby.

When [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Anki Pace|Pace]] showed [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] the scan, he recognized the features as belonging to a [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The remains would later be involved in Horn's duel against [[Shedao Shai]], and the [[Battle of Ithor|devastation]] of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]].
